name: PageGen
summary: AI page generator that turns text, screenshots or templates into React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui pages with live preview.
description: An AI page generator powered by Claude AI that converts text, screenshots or one of 100+ templates into web pages built with React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript and shadcn/ui components. It offers real-time responsive preview with light and dark mode, AI-powered content search, a VSCode-like code editor, animation support and one-click publishing. Credit packs are sold one-time (30 credits $9, 100 credits $19, 200 credits $29).
